children: WELL Health Technologies is looking to link its patients directly with clinical trials with the launch of a consolidated research platform.

The Canadian digital healthcare company said its WELL Research brand will provide full-service contract research organization trial management, running early-phase trials. It also will offer site management organization services that can handle day-to-day patient recruitment and coordination within late-stage trial sites, plus bioanalytical services across a range of trial phases and therapeutic areas.

The research arm will be supported by WELL Health's outpatient clinical network, which is the largest in Canada with 275 clinics that support more than five million annual patient visits. WELL Health also has a provider network, patient consent platform and a service for feasibility assessment and protocol-participant matching.
"For the right patients, in the right setting, a clinical trial is a specialized form of care," WELL Health founder and Chairman Hamed Shahbazi said.
WELL Research will bring together the company's outpatient clinic network in Canada and other operations into a single service for trial sponsors and providers, Shahbazi said.
